def process_sf_film_query(gdf):

    import pandas as pd

    def clean_column_data(series):
        """Remove empty/null/whitespace/stringy-null values from a string Series.

        stringified = series.astype(str)
        exclude = (
            series.isna() |
            (stringified.str.strip() == '') |
            (stringified.str.lower().isin(['none', 'nan', 'null']))
        )
        return series[~exclude]

    try:
        gdf_copy = gdf.copy()

        mask_year_t1 = year_numeric_t1.between(1990, 1999, inclusive='both')

        t1_text_view = None

        film_df_t1 = t1_matched_rows.drop_duplicates(subset=["Title", "Year"], keep="first")

        # 2. Melt actor columns into long form (one (Title, Year, Actor) row per actor per film)
        actor_cols = ["Actor_1", "Actor_2", "Actor_3"]
        actor_table_t1 = (

        )

        actor_table_t1["Actor"] = actor_table_t1["Actor"].astype(str).str.strip()
